newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - CIE started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CIE started as buy.

text.p: Mexican brokerage Serfin started coverage of entertainment company Corporacion Interamericana de Entretenimiento SA (CIE) with a buy rating, the brokerage said in a statement on Monday.
"We expect CIE will report a significant rise in income during the first quarter largely due to the considerable number of events the company handled in early 1997," Serfin said.
Serfin said it expects the company, which began trading on the stock exchange in 1996, to be one of the clear winners of the economic recovery in 1997 and 1998.
CIE B shares were unchanged at 31 pesos on Monday.
